_readme: Spoken narration for the homepage app, in Doug Devitre's ElevenLabs voice.
The words come from journey.json and repos.json (see .github/scripts/narration-clips.sh); this file holds only how they are performed.
Voice settings match Distributed Virtue Season One (profile warm-v2) so both sites sound like the same person.
The voice id is not a secret. The API key is: it lives only in the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY repository secret.
gates_intro: Before you share anything, pass it through four gates.
